summary_md: **Sympathy ([@SympathyLabs](https://x.com/SympathyLabs/status/2115052913919930469))** reports **Ninfer-KVMem-Async** running qwen3.8-27b-coder at 256k context on a 16GB RTX 5080 with 128GB RAM by pipelining host KV page transfers during decode (234.9 vs 188.1 tok/s sync; Apache-2.0).
relevance: KV offload technique for long-context ~27B models on small GPUs.
